ops.en: shrewd, careful, and practical in judgment, especially about money, business, or risk
ops.cn: 精明的；谨慎务实的；尤指在金钱、商业或风险判断方面

ops.en: a deep, narrow valley or gorge with steep sides, often carved by a river
ops.cn: 峡谷；两侧陡峭的深而狭长的谷地，常由河流切割形成

ops.en: to overturn or turn over in water, or to cause a boat or vessel to do so
ops.cn: （使船只）倾覆、翻船

ops.en: a short title or piece of text accompanying an image, table, illustration, or video
ops.cn: 图片、表格、插图或视频的标题/说明文字

ops.en: to provide an image, video, or other item with a caption
ops.cn: 给图片、视频等加标题或说明文字

ops.en: written text displaying spoken words or important sounds in a video or broadcast
ops.cn: 字幕；视频或节目中显示语音及重要声音的文字

ops.en: formal or literary: relating to sexual or bodily desire and pleasure
ops.cn: （正式/文学）肉欲的；与性欲或肉体享乐有关的

ops.note: Broader bodily/flesh sense remains valid, often in moral or religious contexts.

ops.en: to criticize or reprimand someone very severely
ops.cn: 严厉批评；严厉斥责

ops.en: historical: to inflict severe physical punishment
ops.cn: （历史用法）严厉体罚

ops.en: a clouding of the eye's natural lens that can impair vision
ops.cn: 白内障；眼球晶状体混浊并可导致视力下降

ops.note: Also a large or powerful waterfall; literary/general geography use.

ops.en: informal: attractive, appealing, or likely to catch attention
ops.cn: （非正式）吸引人的；讨人喜欢的

ops.en: absolute, explicit, and without qualification or possibility of doubt
ops.cn: 明确无误的；绝对的；无保留的

boundaries.note: British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: severely or bitingly critical, sarcastic, or cutting
ops.cn: 尖刻的；挖苦的；严厉讽刺的

ops.en: to formally express strong disapproval or criticism of someone or something
ops.cn: 正式谴责；严厉批评

ops.value: censure = formally express strong disapproval; censor = suppress, remove, or restrict material. They are distinct lexemes, not spelling variants.

ops.en: a repeated rhythmic word, phrase, or slogan shouted or spoken by a group or crowd
ops.cn: 口号式反复呼喊；群体有节奏重复的词句

ops.en: to repeat words, phrases, or slogans rhythmically, especially as a group
ops.cn: 有节奏地反复吟诵或呼喊

ops.en: a small building or room used for Christian worship, often attached to a larger church, school, hospital, or other institution
ops.cn: 小教堂；用于基督教礼拜的小型建筑或房间，常附属于较大机构

ops.en: abstaining from sexual activity or behavior regarded as improper, often in a religious or moral context
ops.cn: 守贞的；禁欲的；避免被视为不当的性行为

ops.en: simple, restrained, and unadorned in style or design
ops.cn: （风格、设计）简洁朴素、不加装饰的

ops.en: to scold or rebuke someone, often mildly or reproachfully
ops.cn: 责备；训斥；常带较温和或劝诫语气

ops.en: slightly or unpleasantly cold
ops.cn: 微冷的；寒冷而令人不适的

ops.en: unfriendly, unenthusiastic, or lacking warmth in manner or response
ops.cn: 冷淡的；不友好的；缺乏热情的

ops.en: to make a short, sharp, often cheerful sound, as a small bird, insect, person, or device does
ops.cn: 啁啾；吱喳作响；发出短促清脆声

ops.en: the medieval code, ideals, and conduct associated with knights
ops.cn: 骑士精神；中世纪骑士的行为准则与理想

ops.en: courteous or gallant behavior, especially toward women; this extension can sound dated depending on context
ops.cn: 礼貌殷勤的行为，尤指对女性；部分语境可能显得旧式

ops.en: slightly or fairly fat and rounded, especially of a child, face, or body
ops.cn: 胖乎乎的；略胖而圆润的
ops.usage_note: Informal appearance description; use with sensitivity when describing people.

ops.en: following an indirect, roundabout, or unnecessarily long route
ops.cn: 迂回的；绕远的；路线曲折的

ops.note: Also figuratively indirect in speech, reasoning, or conduct.

ops.en: to restrict, limit, or confine something within boundaries
ops.cn: 限制；约束；把……限定在一定范围内

ops.en: polite, courteous, and respectful behavior or speech
ops.cn: 礼貌；文明有礼的行为或言语

boundaries.note: British spelling of the same noun/verb.

ops.en: to make something clean or pure by removing dirt, unwanted material, or harmful substances
ops.cn: 清洁；净化；去除污物或有害物质

ops.en: to remove something considered harmful, corrupting, or unwanted from a system, place, or process
ops.cn: 比喻清除、净化（有害或不需要的事物）
ops.usage_note: Use carefully in contexts involving people or groups, where cleanse can carry violent or euphemistic associations.

ops.en: to gently, patiently, or skillfully persuade or encourage someone or something
ops.cn: 耐心哄劝；循循善诱；设法诱导

ops.en: to force or pressure someone to do something, especially by threats, intimidation, or abuse of power
ops.cn: 强迫；胁迫；尤指通过威胁、恐吓或权力施压

ops.en: the convincing force, persuasiveness, or soundness of an argument or reasoning
ops.cn: 说服力；论证令人信服的力量

ops.note: Formal logical rigor/validity is a narrower branch.
